statements.status_notes: Upstream GHSA-73qp-fwh4-2q5g (https://github.com/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server/security/advisories/GHSA-73qp-fwh4-2q5g) covers atom exhaustion through the runtime-parameter :component segment. It lists the RabbitMQ 3.13 to 4.3 lines as affected, the newest fixed release it names is 4.3.1, and does not list the 4.4 series. In the v4.4.0 and v4.4.1 release tags of rabbitmq-server, lookup_component/1 in deps/rabbit/src/rabbit_runtime_parameters.erl uses rabbit_data_coercion:to_existing_atom/1 and reports an unknown component instead of creating an atom. This package installs the GPG-verified upstream rabbitmq-server-generic-unix release. Its only published build, on amd64 and arm64, is 4.4.1-0, which ships RabbitMQ 4.4.1 (in the amd64 build, its plugin directories are rabbit-4.4.1, rabbitmq_management-4.4.1, rabbitmq_auth_backend_oauth2-4.4.1 and amqp10_common-4.4.1). That build carries the fix, so the range is fixed at 4.4.1-0.

Upstream GHSA-73qp-fwh4-2q5g (https://github.com/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server/security/advisories/GHSA-73qp-fwh4-2q5g) covers atom exhaustion through the runtime-parameter :component segment. It lists the RabbitMQ 3.13 to 4.3 lines as affected, the newest fixed release it names is 4.3.1, and does not list the 4.4 series. In the v4.4.0 and v4.4.1 release tags of rabbitmq-server, lookup_component/1 in deps/rabbit/src/rabbit_runtime_parameters.erl uses rabbit_data_coercion:to_existing_atom/1 and reports an unknown component instead of creating an atom. This package installs the GPG-verified upstream rabbitmq-server-generic-unix release. Its published builds, on amd64 and arm64, are 4.4.0-0, which ships RabbitMQ 4.4.0 (in the amd64 build, its plugin directories are rabbit-4.4.0, rabbitmq_management-4.4.0, rabbitmq_auth_backend_oauth2-4.4.0 and amqp10_common-4.4.0), and 4.4.1-0, 4.4.1-1 and 4.4.1-2, which ship RabbitMQ 4.4.1. Every published build carries the fix, so the range starts fixed at the lowest one, 4.4.0-0.
